caseNameFull: M. H. Momsen, etc. v. National Dredging Company
judges: Hickox, Kirlin, Petitioner, Pillans, Respondent, Smith

opinions.text:
Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied.

Mr. J. Parker Kirlin, Mr. Harry Pillans and Mr. Charles R. Hickox for petitioner. Mr. Gregory L. Smith and Mr. H. T. Smith for respondent.
